instruction: Copy the pricing data, including product code headers and 13 rows, from the LibreOffice Calc sheet into a table in LibreOffice Writer, then save the Writer file as 'envelope_prices.docx' on the desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "s"); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires exporting the complete price table from Calc to Writer. Verified data: Header row contains 'MCC 150072', 'MCC 150006', 'MCC 150063', 'MCC 150066' (first 4 non-empty headers starting from column B). There are 13 data rows (rows 2-14) after the header. Evaluator checks for correct headers, 13 data rows, and verifies actual pricing data content was transferred by measuring content density (at least 30% of data cells must be non-empty to ensure real data transfer occurred, not just empty table structure).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all three main requirements: headers, row count, and actual data content transfer
Content density check (40% of score) ensures actual pricing data was transferred - requires at least 30% of cells to be non-empty (16+ cells out of 52 total)
Header verification checks first 4 expected headers in correct positions (30% of score)
Row count verification checks exact match of 13 data rows (30% of score)
Getter correctly extracts table structure, calculates non-empty cell count and content density metrics
Metric logic correctly combines structural and content verification with appropriate weights
Postconfig appropriately activates Writer window and saves document to ensure file persistence before verification
Minor issue: Only verifies first 4 headers, unclear if source data has additional headers that should be checked, though instruction doesn't specify exact header count
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider verifying all headers from source data if there are more than 4, or clarify in instruction/metadata the exact total header count
